name: outrun-theme
description: Build tooling for the OUTRUN Shopify theme. The theme itself lives in theme/.

scripts.build:3d: esbuild src/3d/outrun-3d.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/* Built from src/3d/outrun-3d.js with npm run build:3d (three.js r160 bundled, MIT). Edit the source, not this file. */" --outfile=theme/assets/outrun-3d.js
